meta.title: Review desk
meta.description: A three-column review workspace for report manuscripts: edit the draft directly on the left (tables and images stay rendered; click anywhere and type, no popups) or read it, choose source checks, logic review, expansion, or connection analysis in the middle (or type your own instruction), and read results on the right. Results filter by tab, the newest opens automatically, and the rest fold to a two-line summary until you expand them. Each card can be revised with one more instruction; a rewrite requirement replaces the selected passage automatically and keeps its record in the results column, with undo on the card. Reviewed passages are marked in the document, and each result can locate its passage, be copied, or replace the original text. Imports .docx and .pdf, converting them to Markdown with their structure kept (headings, lists, bold, tables) and opening the rendered preview; after an import, “Original” renders the file page by page through the local layout engine (read-only, first 8 pages, for checking layout). PDF body text still comes from its text layer, and scans get a clear message. Choose any model route configured in DSH and set its reasoning level independently; add OpenAI-compatible gateways under Settings → Models, where DSH owns the key — this plugin stores no credentials. Each run sends one request to the chosen model, source checks first query the configured web provider, and the document and results stay in this browser.
